Definition: of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset:--assault.
BiblicalUsage: hormḗ means assault. It turns up twice, in Acts and James.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hormḗ as it stands — assault — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
